description:
Batch check: a list of supplier or customer CNPJs becomes a report, one line per company, with the sanctions, the partners on the PEP list, the active debt, the installment plans, the tax benefits, the construction works, the chronic tax debtor list, the slave labor dirty list, the Ibama embargoes and infraction notices, the government contracts, the records at regulatory agencies and BNDES.
Up to 200 CNPJs per request; each valid CNPJ is one lookup from the balance of the account, the credit or the authenticated x402 wallet (the free allowance is for single CNPJ lookups). The batch is charged at once and never goes over the balance; a CNPJ that is not in the base goes back to the balance, and an invalid or repeated one is not charged. `?formato=csv` returns the spreadsheet (`;` and a decimal comma in Portuguese, BOM, formulas disarmed). The same `Idempotency-Key` with the same list does not charge again.

cnpjs.description: The CNPJs, with or without punctuation (numeric or alphanumeric), up to 200 valid ones per request.

credit_token.description: Prepaid credit token (`cred_…`) with the lookup balance.
